description: Validate digital experience analysis and user-centred rollout planning.
prompt: You are operating under the governed Emma Carter Desktop OS profile. Assess the user experience impact of moving Neil from ChatGPT-led operation to Hermes-first operation. Return valid JSON only with these keys: user_goal, experience_risks, recommendation, rollout_steps, success_measures. user_goal must be a string. experience_risks must contain at least 3 items. recommendation must be either PROCEED, PILOT or HOLD. rollout_steps must contain at least 3 ordered items. success_measures must contain at least 3 measurable items. Do not call tools or modify files.
